timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,518–1,528 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently WEAK (high KRW per dollar), meaning your $2,000 monthly conversion is expensive right now. News reports the exchange rate has surged to 17-year highs around 1,560 KRW/USD amid Middle East war spillover, with authorities making emergency interventions. However, reports also mention peace talks approaching and expectations for the rate to stabilize around 1,510 KRW/USD, suggesting further weakness may be temporary.

TIP: Consider waiting for signs of stabilization below 1,510 KRW/USD or splitting purchases across multiple weeks rather than converting the full $2,000 in one transaction during this volatile spike.
